paragraphs.text: Nael is a Yavimayan elf from Dominaria .

Nael was always the curious type, and her curiosity could not be contained by the borders of Yavimaya . As soon as she came of age, she set off to see the world. In her travels, she noticed a flock of avizoa floating in the sky. Several failed experiments later, Nael found herself soaring above the clouds - a view of Dominaria few get a chance to appreciate.
